findings.rule: Shared contract must not import server infrastructure types (type-only imports count; dependencies point inward)
findings.explanation: The domain-layer contract imports the Drizzle row type ReportRunRow from modules/reports/repository (line 3) and embeds it in the wire type ReportDetailDto.latestRun (line 23). This makes the innermost, client-mirrored vendor/shared surface depend on server infrastructure (repository -> db/schema -> drizzle-orm), breaking both the dependency rule and the package mirror the moment the folder is synced into client/, and it lets a raw DB row (workspaceId, Date fields, internal columns) escape to HTTP unmapped instead of being converted at the boundary.
findings.fix: Define latestRun as a Zod schema in the contract (e.g. reportRunSchema with only wire-relevant fields and an ISO-string date), derive ReportDetailDto via z.infer, and map ReportRunRow to that shape in modules/reports/helpers.ts (toReportDetailDto).
